x-openregister._note: planning-long-term-agenda-tracks-and-report task 1 (REQ-LTAT-001): a planned agenda item can be a track under a topic, one level deep (PlannedAgendaTrackGuardListener refuses deeper nesting on save). The topic counts its tracks through declared aggregations. A fragment per ADR-037; PlannedAgendaItem moves to 0.2.0 so an existing install re-imports the schema. Schemas only, no seed objects.

parentItem.title: Topic
parentItem.description: The topic this item is a track of, another planned agenda item. Empty for a topic or a standalone item. One level deep: a track cannot have tracks of its own, and an item with tracks cannot become a track.

trackCount.title: Tracks
trackCount.description: How many tracks name this item as their topic. Materialised by OpenRegister from x-openregister-aggregations. Never written by decidiq.

openTrackCount.title: Open tracks
openTrackCount.description: How many of this item's tracks are still planned or postponed. Materialised by OpenRegister from x-openregister-aggregations. Never written by decidiq.
